descriptive_title: Grade 2 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Lines of Symmetry, Congruence, and Maps (E1.1-E1.5)
subject: Mathematics

curriculum_expectations.E1.1: sort and identify two-dimensional shapes by comparing number of sides, side lengths, angles, and number of lines of symmetry
curriculum_expectations.E1.2: compose and decompose two-dimensional shapes, and show that the area of a shape remains constant regardless of how its parts are rearranged
curriculum_expectations.E1.3: identify congruent lengths and angles in two-dimensional shapes by mentally and physically matching them, and determine if the shapes are congruent
curriculum_expectations.E1.4: create and interpret simple maps of familiar places
curriculum_expectations.E1.5: describe the relative positions of several objects and the movements needed to get from one object to another

unit_overview: A 5-day Grade 2 unit on spatial sense (E1.1-E1.5) framed around 'Mirror Mirror' — Symmy the Symmetry Squirrel and Flippy the Folding Frog. Day 1 sorts shapes by sides, angles, and symmetry lines. Day 2 composes/decomposes and explores area conservation. Day 3 finds congruent shapes. Day 4 creates simple maps. Day 5 closes with a Mirror Maze Capstone integrating all 5 expectations. Each lesson includes an expanded_walkthrough.
unit_learning_goal: Children will sort by sides/angles/symmetry, compose/decompose with area conservation, identify congruent shapes, create maps, and describe positions and movements.

lesson_arc.big_idea: Sort 2D shapes by SIDES + SYMMETRY: count edges, fold to test symmetry.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can sort shapes by sides, angles, and symmetry.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Symmy sorts shapes; children count sides, angles, symmetry lines.

lesson_arc.big_idea: When shapes are REARRANGED, the AREA stays the SAME. Decompose, rearrange, recompose.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can show area stays the same when parts are rearranged.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Flippy rearranges tiles; children explore area conservation.

lesson_arc.big_idea: CONGRUENT shapes are EXACTLY the same — same sides, same angles. We MATCH to test.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Symmy matches pairs; children test congruence by matching.

lesson_arc.big_idea: A MAP shows places from above. We use SYMBOLS for objects.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can make a simple map of a familiar place.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Flippy maps the classroom; children draw their own maps.

lesson_arc.big_idea: We DESCRIBE positions and MOVEMENTS to navigate a maze. Forward, turn, reach the goal.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can describe positions and movements on a map.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Children navigate Symmy's maze; describe positions and write directions.

recurring_characters.name: Symmy the Symmetry Squirrel
recurring_characters.role: Lead character. A friendly squirrel who finds symmetry in everything. Anchors all 5 lessons.
recurring_characters.visual_description: A young squirrel holding a small mirror. Bushy tail with symmetric stripes. Curious, eager expression.

recurring_characters.name: Flippy the Folding Frog
recurring_characters.role: Symmy's partner. The 'folding' character — folds shapes to find symmetry. Cameo Lessons 2-5.
recurring_characters.visual_description: A small green frog holding folded paper. Round eyes, a slight smile. Webbed feet.

threaded_vocabulary.child_friendly_definition: A straight edge of a shape.
A corner where two sides meet.
A line that splits a shape into matching halves.
How much space the inside of a shape covers.
Two shapes that are EXACTLY the same.
A drawing of a place from above.
Going from one place to another.

pedagogical_notes: Grade 2 spatial deepens K/G1 with symmetry counts, area conservation, congruence, and maps.
Symmetry lines: shapes can have 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, or more.
Area conservation is foundational for area concepts in G3.
canadian_context_notes: Use Canadian flag for symmetry (1 line of symmetry).
Maple leaf has 1 line of symmetry.
Tim Hortons logo for shape recognition.
